title: items[].output of 04-documents-to-rag-chunks
description: One page: what the model returned (blocks in reading order, the page as Markdown) and the chunks that start on this page. A chunk never crosses a page boundary. A page that failed has status error and no output (a page the model could not read is `bad_model_output`: it is not retried and the document continues without it).

document.description: Document id from the manifest; pages of one document are chunked together and repeated headers and footers are found across them.

sha256.description: sha256 of the page image file.

markdown.description: The page as Markdown, as the API returned it.

blocks.description: All blocks of the page as returned, in reading order. `dropped` marks header and footer blocks that repeat on other pages of the document: they are not in the chunks.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels of the page image, x2 and y2 exclusive.

text.description: Markdown: headings as # lines, tables as HTML, formulas as LaTeX between $$.

headings.description: The heading path the chunk sits under, from the top heading down (it includes the chunk's own heading when it starts with one).

blockTypes.description: Block types in the chunk, first appearance order.

bbox.description: Merged box of the chunk's blocks on its page.

blocks.description: [page, order] of every block the chunk draws from.

sha256.description: sha256 of the source page image file.
